summary.headline: Solar Industries Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 69% YoY to INR3,519 crore, EBITDA margin 29.02%, and management now expects to beat FY27 revenue guidance of INR14,000 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR3,519 crore (up from INR2,082 crore), with EBITDA of INR1,021 crore (29.02% margin) and PAT of INR650 crore (up from INR361 crore). For H1 FY27, revenue was INR7,187 crore, EBITDA INR2,045 crore and PAT INR1,316 crore. Defense rose to 29% of quarterly revenue (INR1,002 crore) from 24%, while international explosives slipped to 43% from 46% and domestic explosives to 27% from 29%. Management said it expects to surpass the FY27 revenue guidance of about INR14,000 crore and to average around 29% EBITDA margin for the year.

segments.name: Defense
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR1,002 crore, 29% of mix (from 24%); H1 INR1,935 crore, 27% of mix (from 22%). Order book about INR17,568 crore for defense out of total INR20,178 crore, per management.

segments.name: International explosives
segments.commentary: Share of customer basket 43% in Q2 (from 46%) and 40% in H1 (from 42%). Management described momentum as maintained, with deeper customer relationships and improved penetration.

segments.name: Domestic explosives
segments.commentary: Share of customer basket 27% in Q2 (from 29%) and 32% in H1 (from 35%). Management cited a below-average monsoon in mining markets and coal mining demand as drivers of a healthy quarter.

guidance_outlook: Management expects to surpass the FY27 revenue guidance of about INR14,000 crore, given H1 revenue of INR7,187 crore and a seasonally stronger H2.
Management expects defense revenue of about INR4,500 crore in FY27 under the annual guidance and said it could also exceed that.
EBITDA margin for FY27 expected to average about 29%, versus about 28% guided at the start of the year.
Domestic explosives industry growth seen at about 6-7%; Solar targets 10-15% volume growth, though management declined to give FY28-29 domestic guidance.
Management declined to revise formal guidance because of geopolitical, supply-chain and commodity uncertainty.
Pinaka (Guided) order of about INR3,000 crore expected before end of FY27; combined Pinaka family orders about INR9,000 crore.
capex_capacity: Facility for 155 mm products has been set up; management wants more international orders for these products.
Management said the company has built large, integrated facilities covering practically every kind of ammunition, with capacity additions across India supporting domestic growth.
Counter-drone systems are being established in the Indian market, which management said should help win international orders.
Bhargavastra internal trials expected to conclude in calendar 2026, with field trials targeted in the same year; commercial orders are years away.
Omnia acquisition (including an agri business) is pending approvals; management gave no closing timeline and no further update.
demand_pricing: Domestic demand was helped by a below-average monsoon across most mining markets in Q2; management expects stronger H2 domestic sales, citing coal mining demand.
Order book of about INR20,178 crore in total, of which defense about INR17,568 crore; management said most orders are from international markets.
Solar supplies to 90+ countries; exports limited to countries permitted by the Government of India.
Guided Pinaka negotiations are at the final stage; management said the Pinaka family could total about INR9,000 crore across variants.
Missile programs: management expects RFP and contract timelines of roughly 1.5-2 years after trials, so new missile orders are unlikely before about 2 years.

qa_highlights.question: What volume growth is expected from the non-defense business for the rest of FY27 and into FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects better growth in H2 from domestic coal and mining demand; no specific volume number was given for the non-defense business.

qa_highlights.question: Will Bhargavastra orders come this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is too early to comment. Internal trials should finish in calendar 2026, followed by field trials; commercial orders are years away.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY27 guidance be beaten, and will EBITDA margin go above 30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will surpass the INR14,000 crore revenue guidance and expects H1 margin of about 28.45% to average about 29% for the year. Domestic is about 27-28% of revenue and should grow in H2. Management did not commit to margins above 30%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the domestic explosives volume growth outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Industry growth is about 6-7%; Solar targets 10-15% volume growth annually, with management declining to give FY28-29 guidance.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for Guided Pinaka and other defense orders?
qa_highlights.answer: Guided Pinaka (about INR3,000 crore) is expected to be finalised before FY27 end. Management declined to name other programs in negotiation.

qa_highlights.question: When will the Omnia acquisition close?
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave no closing timeline and said it would update the market once approvals are received.

risks_watch: Omnia acquisition: closing timeline and agri business contribution are still unclear, and approvals are pending.
Defense order conversion: Guided Pinaka (about INR3,000 crore) and missile programs depend on RFPs and contract timelines, which management pegs at months to years.
Commodity and supply-chain volatility, including ammonium nitrate prices and geopolitical disruption, could affect margins.
International explosives share fell to 43% from 46% in Q2, and domestic share fell to 27% from 29%, so mix is shifting toward defense.
Management withheld FY28-29 defense and domestic guidance, so visibility beyond FY27 remains limited.
summary.management_tone: Confident on FY27 top-line and margin trajectory, with management stating it will beat revenue guidance. Cautious and evasive on specifics: it declined to size or time Bhargavastra, Omnia, other defense programs, and FY28-29 targets, citing confidentiality and uncertainty.
key_quotes: Based on results, what we achieved, the strength of the order book and the opportunity available for us, we expect to surpass our stated annual guidance, which we have given at the start of the financial year FY27.
And as far as Bhargavastra is concerned, like we have said that we are likely to conclude all our internal trials in this calendar year.
So for next 2 years or after 2 years, we should see orders flowing up from the new missile programs for Solar.
